documents.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
documents.description: Two parties share confidential information with each other to evaluate or pursue a business relationship.

fields.label: Purpose
fields.hint: how Confidential Information may be used
fields.default: Evaluating whether to enter into a business relationship with the other party.

fields.label: MNDA Term
fields.hint: how long the NDA lasts: a number of years from the Effective Date, or "until terminated"

fields.label: Term of Confidentiality
fields.hint: how long information stays confidential: a number of years from the Effective Date (trade secrets stay protected while they remain trade secrets), or "perpetual"; separate from the MNDA Term

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: the state whose laws govern, e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Jurisdiction
fields.hint: the courts for disputes, e.g. "courts located in New Castle, DE"

fields.label: MNDA Modifications
fields.hint: changes to the standard terms, if any

documents.name: Cloud Service Agreement
documents.description: A provider sells a cloud software or SaaS product to a customer on a subscription.

fields.label: Product
fields.hint: the cloud service being provided

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.hint: e.g. "12 months"; it renews automatically unless either party gives notice

fields.label: Fees
fields.hint: what the Customer pays and how often, e.g. "$12,000 per year, invoiced annually"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: the limit on each party's liability, e.g. "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim"

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: e.g. "courts located in Wilmington, Delaware"

fields.label: Technical Support
fields.hint: the support the Provider gives, e.g. "email support on business days"

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.hint: how much notice ends auto-renewal, e.g. "30 days before the end of the Subscription Period"

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Provider defends the Customer against, e.g. "claims that the Product infringes intellectual property"

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Customer defends the Provider against, e.g. "claims arising from Customer Content"

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: the Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

documents.name: Service Level Agreement
documents.description: Uptime and support response targets, with service credits, added to a Cloud Service Agreement.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: the Cloud Service Agreement this SLA belongs to, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027"

fields.label: Target Uptime
fields.hint: e.g. "99.9% per month"

fields.label: Uptime Credit
fields.hint: the credit when uptime is missed, e.g. "5% of monthly fees"

fields.label: Target Response Time
fields.hint: e.g. "4 business hours"

fields.label: Response Time Credit
fields.hint: the credit when the response time is missed, e.g. "2% of monthly fees"

fields.label: Support Channel
fields.hint: how support requests are made, e.g. "support@provider.com"

fields.label: Scheduled Downtime
fields.hint: planned maintenance windows, e.g. "Sundays 2-4am UTC with 48 hours' notice"

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.hint: e.g. "12 months"

documents.name: Data Processing Agreement
documents.description: How a provider processes a customer's personal data under data protection laws such as the GDPR.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: the main agreement this DPA supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027"

fields.label: Nature and Purpose of Processing
fields.hint: e.g. "hosting and support of the Product"

fields.label: Categories of Personal Data
fields.hint: e.g. "names, email addresses, usage data"

fields.label: Categories of Data Subjects
fields.hint: e.g. "Customer's employees and end users"

fields.label: Duration of Processing
fields.hint: e.g. "for the term of the Agreement"

fields.label: Provider Security Contact
fields.hint: e.g. "security@provider.com"

fields.label: Frequency of Transfer
fields.hint: e.g. "continuous"

fields.label: Special Category Data
fields.hint: sensitive data such as health data, if any

fields.label: Special Category Data Restrictions or Safeguards
Approved Subprocessors
fields.hint: e.g. "Amazon Web Services (USA, hosting)"

fields.label: Governing Member State
fields.hint: the EU member state whose law governs the EU Standard Contractual Clauses, e.g. "Ireland"

fields.label: Security Policy
fields.hint: the Provider's security policy, e.g. a link to it

documents.name: Design Partner Agreement
documents.description: An early partner gets access to a product in development in exchange for feedback.

fields.label: Product
fields.hint: the product or service the Partner gets to use

fields.label: Program
fields.hint: what the design partner program involves, e.g. "monthly feedback sessions"

fields.label: Term
fields.hint: how long the agreement lasts, e.g. "6 months"

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: e.g. "courts located in Wilmington, Delaware"

fields.label: Fees
fields.hint: what the Partner pays, if anything

documents.name: Professional Services Agreement
documents.description: A provider performs services and delivers work for a customer under statements of work (SOWs).

fields.label: Deliverables
fields.hint: the services and work the Provider delivers

fields.label: Fees
fields.hint: e.g. "$150 per hour" or "$20,000 fixed fee"

fields.label: Payment Period
fields.hint: how long the Customer has to pay invoices, e.g. "30 days"

fields.label: SOW Term
fields.hint: how long the statement of work lasts, e.g. "3 months"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: the limit on each party's liability, e.g. "the fees paid in the 12 months before the claim"

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: e.g. "courts located in Wilmington, Delaware"

fields.label: Customer Obligations
fields.hint: what the Customer must provide, e.g. "access to its staging environment"

fields.label: Rejection Period
fields.hint: how long the Customer has to reject a Deliverable, e.g. "10 business days"

fields.label: Resubmission Period
fields.hint: how long the Provider has to fix a rejected Deliverable, e.g. "10 business days"

fields.label: Time of Assignment
fields.hint: when ownership of Deliverables passes to the Customer, e.g. "on payment in full"

fields.label: Customer Policies
fields.hint: Customer policies the Provider must follow

fields.label: Insurance Minimums
fields.hint: e.g. "$1,000,000 general liability"

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.hint: claims subject to the higher cap

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.hint: claims with no liability cap

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Provider defends the Customer against

fields.label: Customer Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Customer defends the Provider against

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: the Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

documents.name: Partnership Agreement
documents.description: Two businesses partner, each performing agreed obligations, with terms for payment and trademark licensing.

fields.label: Obligations
fields.hint: what each party will do in the partnership

fields.label: Territory
fields.hint: where the partnership applies, e.g. "United States"

fields.label: End Date
fields.hint: when the partnership ends, e.g. "December 31, 2027"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: the limit on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: e.g. "courts located in Wilmington, Delaware"

fields.label: Payment Schedule
fields.hint: when payments are made, if the obligations include payment

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.hint: how payments are made, e.g. "invoice, paid within 30 days"

fields.label: Brand Guidelines
fields.hint: rules for using each other's trademarks, e.g. a link

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.hint: claims subject to the higher cap

fields.label: Unlimited Claims
fields.hint: claims with no liability cap

fields.label: Company Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Company defends the Partner against

fields.label: Partner Covered Claims
fields.hint: claims the Partner defends the Company against

fields.label: DPA
fields.hint: the Data Processing Agreement between the parties, if any

documents.name: Business Associate Agreement
documents.description: How a provider (business associate) uses and protects protected health information (PHI) under HIPAA.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: the services agreement this BAA supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027"

fields.label: Breach Notification Period
fields.hint: how fast the Provider reports a breach, e.g. "5 business days"

fields.label: Limitations
fields.hint: limits on offshoring, de-identification or data aggregation, if any

documents.name: Software License Agreement
documents.description: A provider licenses software that the customer installs and runs itself.

fields.label: Software
fields.hint: the software being licensed

fields.label: Permitted Uses

fields.label: Subscription Period
fields.hint: e.g. "12 months"; it renews automatically unless either party gives notice

fields.label: Fees

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: the limit on each party's liability

fields.label: Governing Law

fields.label: Chosen Courts

fields.label: License Limits
fields.hint: e.g. "up to 50 users"

fields.label: Payment Process
fields.hint: e.g. "invoiced annually, due in 30 days" or "automatic card payment"

fields.label: Non-Renewal Notice Date
fields.hint: how much notice ends auto-renewal

fields.label: Warranty Period
fields.hint: e.g. "90 days"

fields.label: Deletion Procedure

fields.label: Increased Claims
fields.hint: claims subject to the higher cap

fields.label: Unlimited Claims

fields.label: Provider Covered Claims

documents.name: Pilot Agreement
documents.description: A short trial that lets a prospective customer evaluate a product before a longer-term deal.

fields.label: Product
fields.hint: the product being trialled

fields.label: Pilot Period
fields.hint: how long the pilot lasts, e.g. "90 days"

fields.label: General Cap Amount
fields.hint: the limit on each party's liability, e.g. "$10,000"

fields.label: Governing Law
fields.hint: e.g. "Delaware"

fields.label: Chosen Courts
fields.hint: e.g. "courts located in Wilmington, Delaware"

fields.label: Fees

documents.name: AI Addendum
documents.description: Adds terms for AI features to a main agreement: use of inputs and outputs, and model training.

fields.label: Agreement
fields.hint: the main agreement this addendum supplements, e.g. "Cloud Service Agreement dated January 1, 2027"

fields.label: Training Data
fields.hint: Customer data the Provider may train models on; if none is given, no training is allowed

fields.label: Training Purposes
fields.hint: what that training may be for

fields.label: Improvement Restrictions
fields.hint: limits on using data to improve the product without training
